verdict.rationale: Abacum states that its AI runs inside the financial model, so answers are "grounded in how your business actually works" rather than free-form generation. Separately, it documents traceable statements with drill-down to source data, which suggests lineage. However, nothing shows an external agent can query the engine: no API or MCP surface was found, and OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Nothing ties AI answers to runway, forecast or variance questions with cited lineage either. missing for 10: documented agent/API/MCP access for asking questions, explicit evidence that AI answers return engine-computed figures with lineage attached, runway/variance Q&A examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
